name: 13-shadow-opacity
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 10px 0; line-height: 1.6; } .ts { text-shadow: 2px 2px 3px #999999; } .os { opacity: 0.5; } .bs { box-shadow: 3px 3px 6px #999999; padding: 6px; background-color: #f5f5f5; } .em { text-emphasis: dot; } .tr { text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #f00; }
html:
文字阴影 2px 2px 3px

半透明 opacity 0.5

盒子阴影 3px 3px 6px

着重号 emphasis dot

红色描边阴影
